decision: HOLD: five actionable issues. Additive hint and part anchoring are useful but required frozen geometry and resize contract are not satisfied. No application or product gate approval.

findings.title: Do not add a hint gap when a row has no hint or chord
findings.evidence: Unconditional +3 changes unhinted ten-cell menu natural width16 to19. A real MenuBar with thirty-cell unhinted label opens39 cells instead of frozen36, in TrueColor/Ansi256/Ansi16/Mono. Both direct and MenuBar probes pass parent and fail candidate. Frozen menu.rs:427-431 adds +3 only inside Some(shortcut).
findings.fix: Add gap only when a display hint or effective chord exists; retain measured frozen minimum and shared MenuBar behavior.

findings.title: Restore label space when hints are absent or rejected
findings.evidence: At area width12, inner row width10, unhinted ABCDEFGHIJ now draws only ABCDE; unchanged parent draws ABCDEF. Frozen label width is rows.width−3 (menu.rs:711), permitting seven cells. All four profiles show regression. Current unconditional−5 still reserves two unnecessary cells even after hint admission rejects the hint.
findings.fix: Keep frozen row.width−3 label clip for no/rejected hint; use hint placement/admission to avoid overlap without reducing unhinted labels.

findings.title: Do not subtract title inset twice
findings.evidence: shift(inner,2) already removes two cells; subtracting another2 yields inner.width−4. Width12 menu truncates seven-cell ABCDEFG title to ABCDEF in all four profiles. Frozen menu.rs:633-637 paints at inner.x+2 with inner.width−3. Parent clipping probe passes, candidate fails.
findings.fix: After inset2 retain a single trailing cell, matching frozen inner.width−3.

findings.title: Preserve the frozen shortcut right inset
findings.evidence: Twenty-cell menu row has right19. Frozen menu.rs:742 positions one-cell o at17 (right−width−1); candidate places it16 (right−width−2). Unchanged chord probe passes parent and fails candidate across all four profiles. New display hints use the same incorrect position.
findings.fix: Use frozen right−hint_width−1 position; test chord fallback and borrowed display hints through real rendering.

findings.title: Refresh part anchors after actual resize before the next input
findings.evidence: Public App renders real MenuBar owner at viewport.width/2. Open part-anchored ContextMenu at80x24: layer x41. Harness.resize(100,30) renders owner part x51, but open menu layer remains x41. Its reanchor occurs during update from previous-frame registry, before resized owner is drawn. Existing author test manually redraws then sends z and therefore does not test actual resize ordering.
findings.fix: Resolve anchor against refreshed layout/part registration before presenting or dispatching subsequent input. Preserve one resolved geometry for layer drawing/hits/focus; do not add application coordinate workarounds.

checks.result: 15 passed; 57 filtered/skipped by explicit scope, not a full overlay gate. Existing dynamic chord remap/remove/fallback test passes.

9 run:3 passed,6 failed,0 skipped. Failures are four frozen direct geometry probes, real MenuBar dropdown width, actual resize. Passes: display-only hint rejects false key and pointer activates typed action; missing owner closes open real layer; zero/narrow regions do not panic.

9 run:6 passed,3 failed,0 skipped. All five geometry probes and narrow safety pass before. Added-feature probes fail before: hint absent, removal does not close fixed fallback, resize does not reanchor. Before-only compatibility extension traits are no-op adapters for unavailable APIs; hint omitted from before static constructor because old API lacks const builder. These adapters do not change production source or geometry expectations.

isolated_builds.note: Separate detached sparse read-only product copies and separate per-revision target roots. Test artifacts only in external consumer packages. No product edits, captures, expected updates, helpers or borrowed binary targets.
